scientific_integrity: The homotopy type is explicitly credited to prior work; only the integral symmetry representation and retract basis are new. No claims of independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns three-row, three-forbidden-matching complexes. It relies on published nonequivariant homotopy and an exhaustive 3-by-3 signed-character calculation. Full text of the potentially relevant 2026 Shan–Wang preprint was inaccessible; equivalent unindexed literature remains possible. No independent mathematical audit.
title: An integral hook representation for three-nonmatching complexes of thin complete bipartite graphs
